answer: Problem: clone farms mint keys overnight and flood the next epoch cheaply. Mechanism: a claimant locks 1.75 POA and takes one of 96 public grove slots with a 36-byte kernel receipt (SHA-256 of pubkey||slot||salt). After 27 minutes a coordinator opens a one-shot cipher envelope; the claimant signs the 16-byte payload, bound to that slot, within 11 seconds. Cost: 1.75 POA, a 27-minute unbatchable wait, and a live 11s signature. Verify: unique slot, matching kernel receipt, timely signature. Failure: reused slot, kernel mismatch, or late sign burns 72% and freezes that hash for five epochs.
